name: Ranzo (Italy)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Ranzo (the monogram IHS on blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Ranzo, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 9 May 1997.

features.role: Ranzo arms — monogram IHS on blue, crowned, within branches
